arguments.sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.sets) AS set_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.setCode) AS translated_set_codes,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.translation = '') AS empty_names,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.language = 'English') AS english_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.sets WHERE totalSetSize IS NULL) AS missing_sizes
FROM main.set_translations AS t;

arguments.sql:
WITH qualifying_sets AS (
    SELECT s.totalSetSize
    FROM main.sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN main.set_translations AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
    GROUP BY s.id, s.totalSetSize
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.translation) < 5
)
SELECT SUM(totalSetSize) AS total_cards
FROM qualifying_sets
LIMIT 1
